entries.title: Grouped by tag, tasks waiting on you list in their tags
entries.body: With Tasks grouped by tag, a task waiting on you now lists first in the group of each tag it carries, instead of in a Waiting on you group of its own. A folded tag group still shows those tasks under its bar, where they are blue, so no decision hides behind a fold.

picture.alt: Tasks grouped by tag: the folded bug and No tag groups each list their task waiting on you under a bar with a blue segment
